aboutMe.title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a Computer Science major at Rutgers, with a dual minor in Data Science and Business Administration, and I work mostly in Python, Java, TypeScript, and React.

Right now I'm a Software Engineering Intern at Wells Fargo on the Enterprise Functions Technology team, where I build dashboards for an AI-driven workforce forecasting platform used by the CFO organization for headcount planning. Before that I was an IT Intern at PSEG, where I automated the creation of 4,000+ electric plant data tags and built a lakehouse pipeline on AWS. Earlier, I worked as a Frontend SWE Intern at Movement Labs improving performance on Axial's DeFi frontend, and as Co-Founder & Technology Lead at Vact, shipping features for our mobile app on both app stores.

I'm also co-building Compound AI, a trading-focused platform with 40+ active users that generates personalized investment plans and financial insights. A lot of my work there has been on the retrieval pipeline and guardrails layer that keep the AI's recommendations grounded and explainable.

beyondTheCode.title: Beyond the Code
paragraphs: Outside of work I'm involved in Rutgers Mobile App Development and the Competitive Programming club, both of which keep my problem solving sharp. I like hackathons a lot: my team won first place at HackRU 2024 with a heat-map app analyzing overlap between poverty and pollution data, and more recently I built Rememb-AR at HackPrinceton, an iOS AR app that helps Alzheimer's patients prioritize and recall memories. In my free time I'm usually deep in a personal project or picking up something new.
